reviews.text: A very positive experience with Aristide. The hotel is very well laid out, and the cats can go outside their rooms and socialize. The staff is incredibly attentive. Thank you for the detailed updates and photos during his stay. See you very soon! 😊 …

I have mixed feelings about this cat hotel. First, a little background: I have a 5-year-old female Maine Coon who is with me all the time, and this was the first time we had to board her because we couldn't take her on vacation. The staff allowed us a 48-hour trial so she could see the place, get used to the smells, meet the staff, etc. The staff's availability and attentiveness were a definite plus. However, there are a few drawbacks.

First, you have to be very, very careful about the opening hours. Don't arrive early, and double-check their opening hours if you want to pick up your cat. I had to go back to collect my cat after her 48-hour stay. I specified on the phone before dropping her off, and also to the person who greeted me, that I couldn't pick her up at noon but only at 2 pm because I was in the middle of exams. They confirmed that there was no problem picking her up at 2 pm. Unfortunately, on the scheduled day, I received a call at 1:45 pm (while I was already on my way) to ask if I would still be coming to collect my cat, as it was 1:45 pm and they were closing at 2 pm. I replied that I was scheduled to pick her up at 2 pm, that I had discussed this with two members of the team who were aware of my commitments, and that I couldn't get away any earlier. In the end, I was able to pick her up at 3 pm because a member of the team kindly made an exception.

Secondly: the day before our vacation, my mother went to drop off our cat and asked to see the room she would be staying in. She was told it wasn't possible, that this was only done during the first/trial stay. A surprising response! It was my mother's first time at this place and the first time we had used this type of service. I don't think it's right to refuse a pet owner the chance to see the room where their cat will be staying, under the pretext that it's only done once during the trial stay...

One last point: they'll do anything to make a profit. If you want updates about your cat as often as you like, you have to, IN ADDITION to paying for your cat's stay (which is already quite expensive), pay a fee to get daily updates, for example. A pet is a living being that needs attention and empathy, not a cash cow. It's a real shame: reassuring homeowners as they wish should be part of the basic service and a matter of professional dedication, not an additional paid option.

In conclusion: The team is generally pleasant, and the trial stay concept is a very good initiative. However, the lack of flexibility with scheduling, the refusal to show the property to the owners, and this aggressive sales approach spoil the experience. I leave with very mixed feelings and I'm not sure I'll use their services again.

Our cat Soko (5 years old) thoroughly enjoyed her spacious room, from which she calmly observed her surroundings during her stay at the Aristide Hotel. For our part, we greatly appreciated the availability, respect, and attention to detail of the Miaou Team in every way. Soko will definitely be delighted to return!
The best cat hotel in Paris. The rooms are spacious and the staff is incredibly attentive. They send us updates with photos. Everyone is extremely kind and welcoming. Thank you so much!

Our cat Ulysses had his first stay with the Aristide team. We were quite apprehensive, but the team is fantastic; they reassured us throughout his entire stay. Ulysses had a wonderful time with all his friends, and the hardest part for him was leaving us... In the end, the most difficult part was getting our cat back, who wouldn't stop crying because he wanted to go back! :D We can't wait (especially Ulysses) to repeat the experience when we go on our next vacation.
After two long weeks apart, Ptit'Miss is back in great shape. I highly recommend Aristide and his Miaou-team, who took excellent care of the kitty and her owner. Thank you all, and see you soon.

Bravo and thank you to the whole team who took such kind and loving care of our cat. They are incredibly professional and cat specialists. The hotel is very well-run and perfectly designed for cats. Excellent choice. We've found a fantastic place for our cat and can now go on vacation with peace of mind, knowing our cat will be in good hands again. Don't hesitate to contact them if you need cat boarding :-) Thank you again. Take care of yourselves and all your four-legged companions :-) P. Bastian & JC Tissier

I had to leave urgently for family reasons and unfortunately couldn't take my cat, Mitsu, with me.

Aristide and his entire team were a tremendous help, taking care of Mitsu for over a week. They looked after her wonderfully and regularly sent me photos and updates, which was very reassuring. They played with her and helped her settle in.

Since it was her very first time away from us, she quickly gained their trust.

When it was time to leave, Mitsu didn't want to leave the hotel; she was having fun and felt so comfortable!

A huge thank you to the whole team for everything you did for Mitsu. Your kindness, your attentiveness, and your professionalism. Thank you!

My cat stayed at the Hotel Aristide for several months while we were moving abroad. The care and attention my cat received were exceptional. His health and well-being were given special attention. The staff was great, and the regular updates and photos were reassuring.
Excellent experience at Aristide. The team was caring, professional, and always available — Mokka was pampered as he deserved. He can't wait to go back and play with his great friends.

The place is very well organized and clean, and our cat Zero had a wonderful stay! He came back home well cared for, relaxed, and very affectionate 🥰

Many thanks to the team, who were lovely throughout the entire experience—from the first visit to the stay itself. We were able to enjoy our vacation with complete peace of mind, knowing that Zero was in good hands.

He’s already looking forward to his next vacation 🐾
Aristide Hotel, perfect for welcoming your cats in complete tranquility!

Tara was very happy with her stay at her five-star hotel!
Difficult to get to for suburbanites, but highly recommended for Parisians.
Very quiet location at the end of a cul-de-sac. Top-notch service.

First experience for Perle and her parents...Our worries quickly dissipated when we received photos and videos of a little girl who wasn't traumatized at all...The team was cheerful and professional...everything was perfect...cleanliness, space, food choices...Perle barely acknowledged me after 17 days...preferring to join her friends rather than be held...grrr...anyway...the joys of summer camp...I highly recommend this peaceful place in the heart of Paris.

I wanted to take the time to write this review because Miauteam truly deserves more than five stars.

Leaving my cats for several months, as part of an international move with all the associated paperwork, was a very stressful time for me. There was a lot of waiting, uncertainty, back and forth, and sometimes moments of discouragement.

Throughout this time, Miauteam was incredibly supportive. Always available, always reassuring, with genuine gentleness and a lot of patience. I felt they were taking care of my two feline friends as if they were their own. Receiving regular updates helped me immensely to cope with the separation more calmly.

After several months, I was finally able to reunite with my two cats in Tokyo. They are still a little overwhelmed by their new surroundings, but they are doing well—and I owe that in large part to Miauteam's professionalism and care.

A huge thank you for your support, kindness, and professionalism. I will recommend you without hesitation. 🐾

For several years now, my little Electra (16), a Sacred Birman, has been spending 5 to 15 days there every year.

The staff is very professional and attentive to the cat's well-being.
Hotek is extremely clean.

I'm a very shy girl and didn't want to make any friends during my stay.

I was very comfortable there because my room was spacious, and I definitely preferred the food at Aristide's, whereas at home I stick to my usual kibble and wet food.

After all, I was allowed to be a little fussy since I was surrounded by attentive humans!
All in all, this stay did me a world of good because I learned to appreciate my regular humans even more. They're happy to see that I've changed a bit for the better, with expressive meows and more talkativeness 😂
I'm coming back in a few weeks; perhaps I'll be less timid for this next stay.
My parents thank the entire warm and caring team.

Rhea

It was the first time I'd left my 17-year-old cat, who has a very strong personality, and I don't regret it at all! I was able to enjoy a peaceful holiday knowing she was in good hands. I highly recommend the Hotel Aristide and its very professional and attentive staff.

This was the first time I left my 7-month-old kitten, Athos, at L'Aristide. I'm so glad I chose this place. It offers all the necessary comforts for cats, including water fountains, plenty of toys, and climbing areas. The entire team was very welcoming and always available to answer my questions. I opted for daily updates and loved following Athos's progress. He even made a few feline friends during his stay. It certainly won't be his last time there. A huge thank you to the whole team for taking such good care of him!

*** This was my first time leaving my 7-month-old kitten, Athos. I'm so glad I chose L'Aristide. I cannot recommend this place enough. The place has all the amenities every cat needs, including water fountains and plenty of toys and climbing areas. All the staff were very friendly and super responsive when I had questions. I chose to receive daily updates and I really enjoyed watching Athos' progress. He even made a few feline friends during his stay. This will definitely not be his last stay there. Thank you to the team for taking such good care of him!

It was our little Pixelle's first stay. She spent a month's holiday with Aristide's team, who took excellent care of her. They sent us lovely photos and updates, which allowed us to travel with complete peace of mind. It's amazing how well they adapt to all personalities! Honestly, don't hesitate to entrust your furry friend to them!

Excellent experience for our young cat!

The team is truly fantastic: caring, professional, and attentive. We opted for daily updates, which was very reassuring during our absence and even allowed them to detect a minor case of gingivitis early on. We highly recommend this cat hotel!
Very professional, very affectionate with the cats. We felt reassured throughout our stay, which always went well.

Thank you to the whole team at Aristide for taking such good care of my babies Nahla and Muezza 🥰. I eagerly awaited the daily updates on my girls 😻😻 and I've seen real progress, thanks to the professionalism and attentiveness of the Miaou Team 😽. See you soon for my girls' next vacation 😻😻❤ …

I've always been afraid to entrust my cat to just anyone, so I never did. But with the team at the Hôtel Aristide, I've finally found people I can trust.

They are professional, warm, and incredibly caring. My cat had a wonderful stay while I was away—I asked for daily updates, so I received an email with a recap of his day, adorable photos, and the reassurance that he was being pampered and loved.
It's the only place in Paris where I would leave my cat without hesitation. I highly recommend it: the entire team is wonderful, and I can't praise this place enough!
A wonderful cat hotel, run by wonderful people who deeply love our pets. I've left my little cat there several times and he loves it. Thank you to them!

Cassiopeia and Ulysses stayed for a week at Aristide's. It was their first stay with Aristide and the first time they had left us. Cassiopeia is very shy. The premises are impeccably maintained and the rooms are well-appointed. Cassiopeia particularly enjoyed the skylight that allowed her to observe the hallway and the other rooms. Ulysses seemed to especially like the different levels in the room. But the hotel's real strength is its team: the MiaouTeam. They are attentive to the cat owners and look after the felines with great care and kindness. Cassiopeia relaxed more and more each day and gained confidence thanks to the team. The daily updates, with information about their behavior, along with photos and videos, were much appreciated. I picked up Cassiopeia and Ulysses today. They are very relaxed and settled back into their routines within 10 minutes. I am very satisfied. Cassiopeia and Ulysses will return for their next vacation.

Cochise's first stay at this cat hotel. The space is spotless, very well laid out, and the staff, attentive to each cat's personality, caters to their needs. A wonderful discovery.

I highly recommend this hotel, and Cochise too. He was sleeping peacefully in his round bed when I got back.

Catherine

Our little Loulou had his first stay at the Aristide cat hotel, and the team was fantastic and incredibly attentive. The rooms are designed with cats in mind, and they receive special attention every day! Thank you for the reassuring and lovely updates, which were a pleasure to read along with the photos! We look forward to our next stay :)

What a wonderful discovery this cat hotel was! The staff were attentive, caring, and took excellent care of my kitten, Twisty! He was clearly the hotel's favorite during his stay, thoroughly enjoying this incredible place, with its playroom, private room, playtime with other cats to socialize, cuddles, and more. I highly recommend it!
Hotel meow! My two cats are back in good shape 😂 …

A big first for Archer!! A little shy during his first stay, even a bit grumpy, but he came back calm and so cuddly :) This first experience was a little difficult for him, but when we came to pick him up, he relaxed and started exploring the place, like, "Oh, but actually, it's so great here, I want to stay after all 😅" He didn't want to go back in his carrier.
I 100% recommend Aristide Hotel; the team is incredibly kind and respectful of the cat, its personality, and its emotional state. The rooms are perfectly suited to a cat's needs: small on the floor but tall, which is exactly what a cat needs.
We picked up a calm and peaceful cat (although he did meow a lot on the way home 😅). Even on the subway, he was super curious about what was going on around him, whereas on the way there he was completely withdrawn in his carrier.
Thank you to the whole team, and we'll definitely be back! ❤️
Thank you so much for Woody's first stay, a very nice place and a very attentive team, Woody will be back!

A very warm welcome, the team is very friendly and reassuring! I picked up my little Salazie in great shape and very cuddly. I was happy to hear from her and to know she'd made some friends. Thank you, see you soon!

My little Ramses recently had his first stay at the Aristide Hotel, and I was immediately reassured by the staff's kindness. I was eagerly awaiting their email detailing his adventures.

You can tell that the MiaouTeam truly cares about the well-being of our furry friends, taking the utmost care to ensure they receive sufficient stimulation and adapting to each cat's individual personality.

I would entrust my little cat to them again without hesitation!
A perfect place for cats, a caring and professional team!

A fantastic team who took excellent care of our two little princes; they had a wonderful stay! The team is truly lovely and attentive, providing detailed updates on their activities and personalities during their stay. I highly recommend this childcare option!
Jazz and Opale came home calm and relaxed. You took such good care of them 😸. A big thank you for everything ❤️ …

We entrusted Dora, our little cat, to the Hotel Aristide for the first time and we were delighted with the experience. The entire team was lovely and very attentive to her, sending us updates and photos that reassured us during our absence.

Dora came back calm, in great shape, and even more affectionate than before! We could tell she was pampered and felt comfortable in this calm and caring environment.

Thank you to the whole MiaouTeam for their professionalism and kindness. We won't hesitate to entrust them with our cat's care again for future stays!

Incredible experience! I left my cat for a month at the Dandy room: naturally more of a loner, Loulou became a sociable cat and made a whole bunch of friends! The staff is extremely professional and competent, they really care about your cat and they even send a detailed report of his/her day with cute little photos 😊 100% recommend! …

My little Saraby came to Aristide's for the first time during the February holidays. She stayed for about 10 days and was treated wonderfully! The team took great care of her, and she came back in great shape and very happy!! I highly recommend them!
Great experience for Matchat at Aristide's! He received a lot of attention and was very relaxed upon his return. We were able to receive very reassuring news during the stay accompanied by photos.

The perfect place for you and your cat to have the best vacation ever. The Miaou team takes excellent care of your cat, and the daily emails and photos allow you to see how your cat is settling in. Lennon had a fantastic vacation and met lots of new friends. He has many fans now. A big thank you! 👍 …

Thank you to Aristide for taking such good care of Othello! I was a little anxious as it was his first stay. Othello loved it and came home relaxed with new toys. The updates with photos are very reassuring and absolutely adorable. The team's kindness is incredible!
It's a cat boarding facility, very welcoming even on the phone.

My cats absolutely love this hotel for urban (Parisian!) felines. The "MiaouTeam" staff are kind and knowledgeable. Plenty of space to play. It was our first time, but definitely not our last. Well done, Aristide, for this unique cat experience!

Our 2-year-old male cat had his first 5-day stay. Although he was a little shy around the other cats, he enjoyed watching them from his room and had a great appetite. Thanks to the MiaouTeam, especially Tracy and Léa, who gave me the time to get him settled in his Cosy Cat Room.

Despite our slight apprehension at the time of departure, Meg quickly settled in. She didn't seem in any hurry to leave either… Thank you to the whole team for taking such good care of her and for keeping us updated (the many photos are a real bonus)! 🐱😽 …

First time I'd entrusted my big cat to someone for 8 days. The team was attentive, taking into account the cat's personality and following his pace. Back home, he was exactly the same as ever, but I think that, being such an observant cat, he misses the activity of other cats a little 🤣 …

Our cat spent over 10 days at Aristide's. We found her very sweet and affectionate when we returned. I'm certain everything went well and that the team is caring and attentive to each cat they receive. Thank you, and I won't hesitate to entrust our cat to you again! 😍 …

I left my shy little Pussy with a heavy heart for 15 days. With great patience, kindness, and professionalism, the Aristide team put her at ease, and her stay went very well! I received reassuring updates every day 😃 A huge thank you 🙏 …

Gaufrette had a wonderful first stay and adapted very quickly to her new surroundings :) The enclosures are spacious, with plenty of vertical space and a good view, perfect for curious cats. The staff is available and attentive to each …
